title: Install a Python command-line tool using pipx
summary: Use pipx to install Python applications in isolated environments. This makes the tool available in your terminal without affecting your main Python installation.

aliases.text: how to install black with pipx

steps.explain: Install the specified Python package. pipx creates an isolated virtual environment for it and adds the executable to your PATH.

placeholders.name: PACKAGE
placeholders.description: The name of the Python package to install (e.g., black, httpx-cli)

steps.expect: The package is installed and a success message appears.
